successors.name: British Cape Colony
successors.text: 'located between the Umzimkulu and Kinira Rivers, south of the Sotho Kingdom'

ledger.x: 1862: Adam Kok III's Griqua settle at the laager in Griqualand East after the trek ('In 1861 most of these inhabitants embarked on an exhausting journey'; 'they left their homeland under duress to go into exile in 1863'; infobox 'Laager: 1862').

1872: the Griqua leave the laager near Mount Currie and found Kokstad, 'named in honour of their leader'; the text places the move and the founding in 1872, the infobox gives 'Move from Mt.Currie: 1869' and 'Kokstad founded: 1872'.
1877: the Cape Parliament annexes Griqualand East.
1877: the Griqua state ends with the annexation act (the infobox gives 'annexation 1874 ~ 1879'; Adam Kok III died in December 1875).

certainty.note: Only two rivers bound it; the 20,000 km2 is 'a maximum estimate of unclaimed or un-annexed land'.
